items.prompt: The tax rate 0.17 appears in the cart, the invoice PDF and the refund calculator; one was missed when the rate changed.
items.why: Duplicated knowledge drifting apart → DRY. Put the rule in one place.

items.prompt: For a 2-day coding task with one database, a candidate builds a generic repository layer, a plugin loader and an event bus 'for future flexibility'.
items.why: Building for unstated requirements → YAGNI/KISS. No pattern is missing; there are too many.

items.prompt: A report controller does `report.owner.team.manager.email` to send a notification, and breaks every time the org model changes.
items.why: Long call chains through strangers → Law of Demeter; tell the report to `notify_owner_manager()`.

items.prompt: `Penguin` extends `Bird`, and `Penguin.fly()` raises NotImplementedError; code that loops over birds and calls fly() crashes.
items.why: A subtype that can't honour the parent's contract → Liskov substitution (SOLID). The fix may be composition, but the principle named is LSP.

items.prompt: A game has `FlyingFireEnemy`, `FlyingIceEnemy`, `WalkingFireEnemy`, `WalkingIceEnemy`… adding 'swimming' would add three more classes.
items.why: Subclass explosion along independent axes → composition over inheritance (movement and element as components).

items.prompt: A user can change their sort order (by price, by rating, by distance) while browsing, and the results list must re-sort without being rebuilt.
items.why: A concrete recipe (an interface for the sort rule, swapped at runtime) is being asked for → Strategy. Composition is the principle underneath, but the question wants the pattern.

items.prompt: `UserService` handles sign-up, password hashing, sending welcome emails and generating monthly PDF reports.
items.why: Several unrelated reasons to change in one class → SRP (SOLID). Low cohesion is the same idea in general terms, but SRP is the named rule.
